beats: Daksha cursed the Moon to fade
Chandra prayed to Shiva at Prabhas
Shiva eased the curse: wax, wane

beats.line: Cursed by Daksha, the Moon begins to fade
Chandra prays at Prabhas — Shiva appears as light
The curse is eased: the Moon waxes and wanes
Somnath, Lord of the Moon, rises by the sea
